slides.texte_overlay:
Man to Man
This is how you move on
properly (Part 2)

1. Tell one person the truth
Not the whole group chat.
One friend you trust.
Saying it out loud
takes some of its weight away.

2. Return what's theirs, once
One box. One handoff.
No "I still have your hoodie"
excuses to see them again.
Clean endings make
clean starts.

3. Take back your evenings
The hours you used to
spend together are the hardest.
Fill them on purpose:
a class, the gym, a friend.
Empty evenings are where
old thoughts live.

4. Don't trash them
Not online.
Not to mutual friends.
How you end something
shows who you really are.

5. Say yes to plans
The dinner you'd normally skip.
The trip with the boys.
Life shows up when
you leave the house.

6. Start something
that's only yours
A new skill. A new subject.
Learn one new thing every day.
Grow something that has
nothing to do with the past.
